articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-context coherence up to 1M tokens and reduces hallucination rates by roughly 40% compared to GPT-5's initial release. Enterprise API pricing was cut by 30%, signaling OpenAI's push to maintain dominance amid intensifying competition from Google and Anthropic.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Model Achieves Zero-Shot Manipulation of Novel Objects
articles.summary: DeepMind published results from its Gemini Robotics Foundation Model (GRFM-2), demonstrating that a single vision-language-action model can manipulate previously unseen objects with a 92% success rate in unstructured environments without any task-specific fine-tuning. The system leverages a massive dataset of simulated and real-world robotic interactions paired with Gemini's reasoning capabilities. This represents a meaningful step toward general-purpose robotic manipulation and could accelerate deployment in warehousing and household applications.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 'Sentinel' System for Autonomous AI Safety Monitoring
articles.summary: Anthropic unveiled Sentinel, a dedicated AI oversight system designed to continuously monitor other AI agents for alignment violations, unsafe tool use, and emergent goal-seeking behavior in real time. The system operates as an independent evaluation layer that can pause or override agent actions when it detects deviation from specified safety constraints. The release comes amid growing regulatory pressure in the EU and US for companies deploying autonomous AI agents to implement verifiable safety guardrails.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Automotive Manufacturing
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially announced commercial availability of the electric Atlas humanoid robot tailored for automotive assembly lines, developed in partnership with parent company Hyundai. The platform can perform over 40 distinct manipulation tasks including precision part insertion, heavy lifting up to 25 kg per arm, and quality inspection using onboard vision systems. Initial deployments are slated for Hyundai and Kia factories in South Korea and the US, with third-party sales opening in Q1 2027.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Transistor Chips
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Kaohsiung fab. Early benchmark data suggests an 18% performance gain and 25% power reduction over the N2 node, with Apple and Nvidia among the first customers. The milestone reinforces TSMC's manufacturing lead and is expected to enable next-generation AI accelerators with significantly improved performance-per-watt ratios.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 288B Active Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights and training methodology for Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts model with 288 billion active parameters routed from a 1.2 trillion total parameter pool. Benchmarks show it matching or exceeding GPT-5 on reasoning-heavy tasks like GPQA and ARC-AGI while remaining deployable on 8×H200 clusters thanks to efficient expert routing. The open-source release is expected to significantly impact the open model ecosystem and further pressure proprietary API pricing downward.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with 4,096 Electrodes
articles.summary: The FDA granted clearance for Neuralink's N2 implant featuring 4,096 electrodes — a fourfold increase over the original N1 device — enabling significantly higher-resolution neural signal capture. Early clinical trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks and preliminary two-handed robotic arm manipulation. The clearance covers a 50-patient expanded trial, marking a critical regulatory milestone for consumer BCI technology.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Full Assembly Line Integration
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots have moved beyond pilot programs to full production-line integration at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, with over 200 units operating across three shifts. The robots handle component transfer, bin picking, and inspection tasks alongside human workers with a reported 99.2% uptime. Figure disclosed a $1.5 billion Series C round to fund scaling production to 10,000 units annually by 2028, reflecting surging industrial demand for humanoid labor platforms.
